desc:
No one knows how the races waiting in your future will end. But you will continue to run, aiming only toward the goal in front of you.

————————————————————————————


PC Controls:
- W/S : Control Speed
- A/D : Turn
- F : Quick Time Event
- 1,2,3,4,5 : Trait Usage (For specific traits)
- G : Ultimate
- Z/C : Look backwards
- B : Emote

————————————————————————————


Xbox Controls:
- Thumbstick : Left/Right steering.
- Left Trigger : Slow Down
- Right Trigger : Speed Up
- A : Quick Time Event
- X : Trait Usage (For specific traits), Bindable
- Y : Ultimate
- Bumpers : Look backwards
- Right Thumbstick Held: Emote

You may switch the thumbstick controls in the settings menu.

————————————————————————————

Your keybinds can be changed through the settings in the game.

Private servers can use commands. Type in "commands" in the chat to see what commands are in the game.

Inspired by Uma Musume.

————————————————————————————

You can get extra rewards in the AFK world if you have premium!
